description: Use when you monitor several endpoints: up to 10 http(s) URLs in one POST, each checked exactly like /v1/uptime/ping (status, latency, redirects, TLS, server) from Cloudflare's edge. Bad input is refused before any charge. For one URL use url_uptime_ping. With a P0 access key (header Authorization: Bearer p0k_…, buy one at https://x402-bazaar-rank.x402-bazaar-rank-worker.workers.dev/keys/buy?usd=5) this tool makes the paid call itself and returns the data, deducting the listed price.
